name: Torbran
description: A character of Red Fell tasked with luring the Phyrexians into the trap.

description_citations.text: "Eldraine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: A Phyrexian dog attacks Rankle and Torbran kills it with his axe.
timeline.quote: he opened his eyes and saw the beast in two halves and a red-bearded dwarf yanking his axe out of the carnage

citation.work: March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Torbran tells Rankle the courts have fallen and that they must stand at Locthwain; Rankle sees this as a chance to reach Ayara.
timeline.quote: "The courts have fallen," the dwarf said in a quivery voice.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Rankle transforms Torbran's ring into a caterpillar and steals it while he sleeps.
timeline.quote: The ring had transformed into a caterpillar.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Rankle uses the ring to wish for a basket of cookies and then a love potion, refusing to return it.
timeline.quote: "I wish for a love potion!" Rankle interrupted.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Rankle and Torbran see Locthwain crashed to the ground, its knights and the queen transformed by Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: To Rankle's shock, she was not herself.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Rankle hands over the ring but wishes the love potion to rain down, and a chasm opens as the pink rain falls on the horde.
timeline.quote: Instantly, the skies opened, and drops of pink rain began to fall.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Eldraine: The Adventures of Rankle, Master of Love" by Jenna Helland. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Rankle inadvertently completes the trap just as the Phyrexians fall under the Wicked Slumber.
timeline.quote: Rankle inadvertently brought the plan to fruition just as the Phyrexians fell under the Wicked Slumber .

citation.text: "Eldraine", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: A red-bearded dwarf with a magical golden wishing ring who needs the ring to lure the invaders into a chasm.
